name: Amelia
tagline: A second brain for air traffic controllers: surfaces missed risks from live flight and weather data.

awards: Best Use of Vibe Kanban by Vibe Kanban

problem: Air traffic control is understaffed, worsened during a government shutdown, the team says.
solution: Fuses real-time flight and weather data, surfaces insights and automates routine work while keeping the controller in the loop.
demo_moment: Team-described: see a conflict flagged on the live map with a suggested action.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Use of Vibe Kanban by Vibe Kanban” among 195 submissions.

lessons: Keep the human in the loop explicit for safety-critical AI.
